summary: Smith+Nephew announced via Form 6-K that CFO John Rogers will resign on 30 September 2026 to take an external US position, following completion of H1 results. He steps down from the Board with immediate effect; Pierre Palassian, SVP Finance and Group Controller, becomes interim CFO. No severance; awards lapse per ordinary leaver rules. A search for a successor has begun. The departure is voluntary, disclosed in line with UK Companies Act requirements. Watch for successor announcement and any strategic implications under the RISE plan.
